body:
# `sprite`

Instantly preview any Minecraft texture in chat, titles or UI! No resource pack required! Great for server owners, admins and game designers to create a more modern player experience. #### sprite stays updated with the latest textures for your server version, as we dynamically grab and generate the textures from the client jar for your specific server version. You'll only ever need (want) to update this plugin for improved features, never for texture updates! --- **quick in game showcase (menu + title displays)**

**Commands you'll (hopefully) use** | Command | What it does | |------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | `/sprite` or `/sprite view` | Opens the root atlas list (use `/sprite page ` to jump around). | | `/sprite view [page ]` | Shows sprite groups for the given atlas; accepts `minecraft:` or simple IDs. | | `/sprite preview ` | Pops the sprite into your title bar for the configured duration. | | `/sprite reload [all/atlascache]` | Forces a cache refresh; always async, safe to use if Mojang updates textures. |
**I have a suggestion! Can you implement this feature?** I'd love to implement your (hopefully relevant) ideas into this plugin! If you have any improvements or suggestions, leave a Github issue, or join the Discord! - [Github Issues](https://github.com/haroldDOTsh/sprite/issues) - [Discord](https://discord.gg/X7XjmsF5uz) Hope to see you there! --- > Do be advised that I have noticed that some custom clients (I tested with Lunar) do not seem to render custom icons very well. Be careful!
